project.name: GoalKick
project.descriptor: AI-powered soccer field booking and management platform

requirements.statement: The system must allow customers to view available soccer fields.
The system must allow customers to choose a date and time for booking a field.
The system must allow customers to book a soccer field.
The system must provide an AI assistant to answer customer questions about pricing and availability.
The system must use AI agents to assist with customer service.
The system must use AI agents for scheduling.
The system must use AI agents for basic business analytics.
The system must send important decisions such as refunds and complaints to a human for approval.
The system must detect available and unavailable soccer fields.
The system must detect booking conflicts.
The system must detect customer requests.
The system must detect scheduling issues.
The system must detect busy and slow booking periods.
The system must identify when an issue needs to be sent to a human for approval.
The system must connect to the booking database.
The system must connect to the customer information database.

stories.title: Customer views available soccer fields
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want to view available soccer fields, so that I can decide which one to book.
acceptance_criteria: Given the fields listing page, when a customer opens it, then all soccer fields with their current availability are shown.
Given a field with no open slots, when a customer views it, then it is clearly marked unavailable.

stories.title: Customer books a soccer field
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want to book a soccer field for a chosen date and time, so that I can secure it for my game.
acceptance_criteria: Given an available field, when a customer selects a date and time and confirms, then the booking is created and confirmed to the customer.
Given a field already booked for the selected slot, when a customer attempts to book it, then the booking is rejected with a clear reason.

stories.title: AI assistant answers customer questions
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want an AI assistant to answer my questions about pricing and availability, so that I get quick answers without waiting for staff.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer question about pricing or availability, when it is asked to the AI assistant, then an accurate answer is returned.

stories.title: Human approval for refunds and complaints
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want refund and complaint decisions routed to a human for approval, so that sensitive customer situations are handled with judgment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refund or complaint request, when it is submitted, then it is routed to a human for approval before any action is taken.
Given a pending refund/complaint decision, when a human approves or denies it, then the outcome is recorded and the customer is notified.

stories.title: Detect booking conflicts
stories.narrative: As a scheduler, I want the system to detect booking conflicts, so that no field is double-booked.
acceptance_criteria: Given two booking requests for overlapping times on the same field, when the second is submitted, then the system flags a conflict before it is confirmed.

stories.title: AI-assisted scheduling
stories.narrative: As a scheduler, I want AI-assisted scheduling, so that bookings are arranged efficiently around existing commitments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booking request, when the AI scheduling assistant processes it, then it proposes a slot that avoids known conflicts.

stories.title: AI provides business analytics
stories.narrative: As a business owner, I want AI-generated business analytics, so that I can understand booking trends and performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given booking data over a period, when the analytics agent runs, then it produces a summary of trends including busy and slow periods.

stories.title: AI answers complex customer queries
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want the AI to answer complex questions I have, so that I get useful help beyond simple FAQs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a complex customer query beyond pricing/availability, when it is asked, then the AI provides a relevant answer or escalates it appropriately.

stories.title: Comprehensive customer service with AI and human escalation
stories.narrative: As a customer, I want comprehensive customer service that combines AI and human escalation, so that my issues get resolved appropriately.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer service issue that cannot be resolved by AI alone, when it is identified, then it is escalated to a human.

stories.title: Optimize system performance for user interactions
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want the system's performance optimized for user interactions, so that the platform stays responsive as usage grows.
acceptance_criteria: Given expected user load, when the system is under typical usage, then interactions remain within an acceptable response time.

stories.title: Establish trust spine with audit trail for bookings
stories.narrative: As a system auditor, I want an audit trail for bookings, so that I can verify booking activity is trustworthy and traceable.
acceptance_criteria: Given any booking action, when it occurs, then an audit trail entry is recorded with who, what and when.
Given a system auditor reviewing the audit trail, when they trace a booking, then they can follow it back to its origin.

stories.title: Detect scheduling issues and notify users
stories.narrative: As a scheduler, I want the system to detect scheduling issues and notify users, so that problems are caught and resolved early.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scheduling issue such as a conflict or cancellation, when it is detected, then the affected users are notified.
